why: Founder-led milestone posts are what works on our Instagram; X rewards the raw version.
text:
15 days since launch. 250 customers, 4.9 on verified reviews, 10 reorders.

The review we keep rereading is from a son whose mom now falls asleep much earlier. SILT began with our founder's 3 PM crashes in corporate. We never pictured parents being the first it helped.
